$comment: Package-level state that deliberately survives a scope change (CLIENT-11). scripts/user-state-registry.test.mjs fails on any package store or module let that no reset seam clears and that is not listed here; each entry says why it outlives an account. `path#*` lists every module value in a generated file.

state.packages/auth/src/pending-invite.ts#acti: the invite a signed-out visitor arrived with must survive sign-in to be redeemed; the composition root swaps its storage, and redemption consumes it
state.packages/i18n/src/gen/runtime.js#*: generated Paraglide runtime caches; the locale itself is re-negotiated by each app's locale leg
state.packages/onboarding/src/signal-channel.t: a monotonic id that tells two identical signals apart; it carries no account data
the device's reduced-motion media query, cached once
state.packages/ui/src/theme/background-store.t: presentation-only background tone; no account data
state.packages/universe/src/proposal.ts#memory: a monotonic React-key counter for proposal drafts; it carries no account data
state.packages/universe/src/universe-view-stor: the pinned or free camera choice belongs to the device and survives account switches
